sources.title: Original ImageGen concept sheet corresponding row
sources.notes: Aesthetic only. A concept cylindrical volume and open crown retained. Concept stars can look flat and cruciform; override every sclerite with five real rays including one prominent radial outward ray and four tangential arms. These satisfy reported4–7 total rays; do not substitute Allonnia three-ray morphology. Body tapers narrower toward attachment base, not a flowerpot. Crown dense spaced stars, open recessed interior with wall thickness. No substrate or scenic pedestal. Dark interior is cavity not painted disc at top.
